liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): The reviewer feels the Shakedown Street performance is personally speaking to them; The Shakedown Street performance is rated very good, while the first set is average [7][10][12]
- **Wang Dang Doodle** (1 review): The song followed the opener with a nice bluesy feel [12]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Vince Welnick's keyboard playing is described as missing, making the performance clunky [10]

## The recordings

- **gd94-12-15.akg.ladner.14266.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 16 songs; 161 min; rated 2.86/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1994-12-15.156395.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 16 songs; 154 min [5]
- **gd1994-12-15.141237.FOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 16 songs; 162 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1994-12-15.akg.seff.3469.shnf**: source not stated; 16 songs; 161 min [3]

## Around the show

- The reviewer was offered double their ticket price but declined, wanting only the Dead [9]
- Holiday shoppers filled aisles in the Sports Arena west lot during the opener [11]
- A friend bailed to a Jeep, found with all four seatbelts plugged in [11]
- The show is characterized as typically sloppy and lackluster for the 1994 tour [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-12-15.akg.ladner.14266.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Audience: AKG 460B/CK8 [1]. Also: The recording is a ShnTool fix of Jon Seff's AKG seed [1]
- **gd1994-12-15.156395.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by David Beckwith; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 31, 2022; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Tapes were made for Vince Welnick by Dick Latvala and supplied by David Beckwith [5]
- **gd1994-12-15.141237.FOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16 44.1khz Source Info: FOB Schoeps MK 4-> Reutelhuber P/S-> DAT.Transfer Info: Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD (Late 90's)Extract… [2]
- **gd1994-12-15.akg.seff.3469.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: AKG 460B + CK8 > D3 @48k [3]
